Hi Jodie / Solara PMO team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get this moving. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Solara_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a simple network diagram for the on-prem integration (network_diagram_v2.png). High level ask: can your team review the milestone owners and committed dates below and confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the onboarding roster?

Proposed 90-day activation cadence (high level):
- Week 0 (Dec 6): Kickoff + environment access checklist complete (owner: Solara PMO)
- Weeks 1–2: Infra prep & network validation (owner: Solara SRE)
- Weeks 3–6: Model onboarding & test traffic (owner: Redwood engineering)
- Weeks 7–10: Feature enablement, ACLs, and observability hooks (owner: Solara platform)
- Weeks 11–12: Acceptance testing and cutover windows (owners: joint)

Immediate asks for your confirmation:
1) PM owner for infra validation (name + email)
2) Any blackout dates between Dec 13–Jan 10
3) Approval to run a short pre-prod smoke test on Dec 21 (2 hour window)

If we have owners locked by Wednesday we will publish a detailed RACI in the MAP.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
